title: "AMLR glider deployments"
page-layout: full

Slocum glider deployments around the South Shetland Islands and the Antarctic Peninsula,
from NOAA's Antarctic Marine Living Resources (AMLR) program. Filter the map by start year
or deployment name; click a track and choose **Open 3D curtain** to explore temperature,
salinity, chlorophyll and oxygen along that deployment.
